dataType.description: The Type that should be invoked to retrieve data for the {@link PdfComponent}.

actionName.description:
The default actionName to use in the {@link PartiallyAppliedAction} returned by
{@link PdfFieldBasedGetDataSpec#componentPartiallyAppliedActions}.

actionArgs.description:
The arguments supplied to {@link PdfComponentDataSpec#actionName}. No arguments supplied
if not specified.

fieldSpecs.description:
List of {@link PdfComponentFieldSpec}s that specify the fields on the type
to display in the definition list.

entityId.description: The ID of the entity to retrieve for the Type in {@link PdfFieldBasedGetDataSpec#dataType}.

title:
Extension of {@link PdfComponentDataSpec} that specifies data retrieval for an
{@link PdfComponent} using the get action.
name: PdfFieldBasedGetDataSpec
